index.meta.title: troid's desk — prop-firm risk, computed
index.meta.description: Prop-firm risk and compliance, computed. Size against both loss ceilings, net of fees.
index.hero.lede:
Most funded accounts fail on position size, not entries. troid computes
  both of your loss ceilings, reports which one actually binds, and sizes the trade net
  of fees.
index.firms.eyebrow: Firms · alphabetical · every firm troid lists, no cap
index.firms.why:
{firm} is the reference firm because troid verified it first and most completely, not because it ranks highest.
    Each rule on troid's compare shows the firm document and the date troid read it, or says its source is not yet
    recorded. Which firm gets verified next follows propfirmmatch's review ranking; the page has no cap. troid is an independent affiliate of the
    firms it compares; where a code is shown it's cheaper through the affiliate link, where it isn't it's the same price.
    troid computes, you choose.
index.stats.failures.p:

index.does.p:
Computes both loss ceilings and reports the binding one. Sizes positions net of the
  0.04%-per-side fee. Checks trades against firm rules — the ten-day maximum hold, the
  margin concentration limit, the five-day minimum. Works across every challenge type and
  every asset the firm lists.
index.doesnt.p: Publish trade signals. Place orders. Touch your credentials. Sell you a strategy.
index.doesnt.tools: TROID.md is troid's rules and arithmetic as one file — paste it into any assistant as a system prompt. The MCP server does the same for Claude Desktop or Cursor, with exact arithmetic.
index.doesnt.verify: Every figure here is arithmetic you can check. verify_claims.py in the repo re-derives each published number from first principles and tags it by confidence tier — derived, sourced, modelled, or measured. A measured number is never stated as fact.
